# Ledger schema 1

Task id, status/state, owner, and nonempty UTC time are required. metadata is optional and may contain arbitrary JSON values.
Operation task_id must resolve to a task; request.at and recorded_at must be nonempty UTC times with request.at <= recorded_at. after_record is the resulting task record.
Receipt task_id, run_id, recorded_at, expected_head, tested_head, reviewer, summary_path, and verification are required. Both head fields must equal the target commit and match the captured run summary. A reviewer different from the task owner attests the receipt.
verification.duration_ms is a nonnegative integer, so zero is valid for this coarse millisecond counter. verification.notes is optional and may be null. verification.residuals is an array and is empty on a clean pass.
All files below are captured within the supplied tree. No record is omitted or redacted.
